interfaces_exposed: Projected online multinomial head on frozen192dimensional transformer features. Matrix205x192 starts atzero and resets at original piece boundaries. phi=xn/sqrt(1+sum(xn^2)). q=softmax(capped_base_logits+Aphi). First prediction after reset preserves native base probabilities exactly. Update A+=0.25*(onehot(truth)-q)*phi^T; project Frobenius norm to3.999999 when norm exceeds4. All observations are decoded tokens, including piece-final tokens; PPM-only first tokens have no pending head prediction.
